blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) will end the yearby launching two services to India from Manila as part of a broader push to strengthen air links between the two Asian economies. Starting December 2026, the airline plans to operate thrice-weekly flights to Delhi and four weekly services to Mumbai using its Airbus A320neo aircraft, which can seat 168 passengers across business and economy classes. READ: India’s largest airline moves to enter PH market PAL’s planned services are still subject to approval by the Indian government.
